Name: Pet Quests
Author: xzcute
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8BZcKrA.png[/img]
[font=Arial][size=4]Talk to your pet in the morning and pick a quest. They head out for a configurable number of in-game hours and come back with results or don't, if things went sideways. A small icon floats above them so you can tell at a glance whether they're available (❗) or still out (🦴). [/size][/font]

[font=Arial][b][size=4]Cats[/size][/b][size=4] can go hunting, foraging, fishing, mining, or artifact hunting. They would've done all of this anyway. Now you at least get something out of it. [/size][b][size=4]Dogs[/size][/b][size=4] go on fetch missions, farm guard duty, fishing, digging, or treasure hunting. They are trying very hard. Please acknowledge this. [/size][/font]

[font=Arial][size=4]Results come in at Normal, Silver, Gold, or Iridium quality, with failure as a real possibility. The trust system affects your odds a pet you've actually been talking to performs better and leaves with more energy. One you've been ignoring? They remember. The loot reflects this.[/size][/font]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Sq719Fh.png[/img]
[color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Arial]★ [/font][/size][/color][size=4][font=Arial]5 quest types per pet, each with distinct reward pools[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Arial]★ [/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial]Quality tiers on loot (Normal through Iridium), including outright failure[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Arial][color=#f1c232]★[/color] [/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial]Trust system affecting success rates and departure behavior[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Arial]★ [/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial]Return dialogues that vary depending on how the quest went and how your pet feels about you personally[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Arial][color=#f1c232]★[/color] [/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial]Optional sound alert on return[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Arial]★ [/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial]Quest status icon above your pet (toggleable, if you'd rather not be judged by a floating emoji)[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Arial][color=#f1c232]★[/color] [/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial]Auto-return after 8 PM if they're still out[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Arial]★ [/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial]Full Generic Mod Config Menu support[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Arial][color=#f1c232]★[/color] [/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial]Localization[/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial]: English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese[/font][/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MuD1FeI.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][font=Arial][size=4]Install [url=https://smapi.io/][b][color=#f1c232]SMAPI[/color][/b][/url] if you haven't already[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][size=4]Drop the PetQuests folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][size=4]Launch the game through SMAPI[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][size=4]Talk to your pet they've been waiting[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Arial][size=4]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu to adjust settings in-game. Otherwise, edit config.json directly.[/size][/font]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/evYQ2Zi.png[/img]
[list]
[*][font=Arial][size=4][url=https://smapi.io/][b][color=#f1c232]SMAPI[/color][/b][/url][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b][color=#f1c232]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/b][/url] [i](optional)[/i][/size][/font][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2gqJN1C.png[/img]
[font=Arial][size=4]Works on existing saves. Doesn't write directly to save data, so it's safe to add or remove mid-playthrough. No known conflicts with other mods.[/size][/font]
